notes: Default dialect coverage is measured by executable regression cases that use PostgreSQL-compatible SQL, including the base-entry DDL Query Graph contract. Official syntax coverage is tracked in postgresql_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
MySQL coverage is measured by executable dialect cases, including the base-entry DDL Query Graph contract. Official syntax coverage is tracked in mysql_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
Oracle coverage is measured by executable dialect cases, including the base-entry DDL Query Graph contract. Official syntax coverage is tracked in oracle_official_syntax_coverage.csv.

SQL Server coverage is measured by executable dialect cases, including official hook-coverable cases, basic forms of mixed-model official entries, and the base-entry DDL Query Graph contract. Official syntax coverage is tracked in sqlserver_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
Dameng coverage is measured by executable dialect cases, including the base-entry DDL Query Graph contract. Official syntax coverage is tracked in dameng_official_syntax_coverage.csv.

Vastbase PostgreSQL compatibility mode uses an explicit dialect and its own executable PostgreSQL-compatible regression cases. Official syntax coverage is tracked in vastbase_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
Vastbase MySQL compatibility mode uses an explicit dialect and its own executable MySQL-compatible regression cases. Official syntax coverage is tracked in vastbase_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
Vastbase Oracle compatibility mode uses an explicit dialect and its own executable Oracle-compatible regression cases. Official syntax coverage is tracked in vastbase_official_syntax_coverage.csv.

Vastbase SQL Server compatibility mode uses an explicit dialect and its own executable SQL Server-compatible regression cases, including official hook-coverable cases and basic forms of mixed-model official entries. Official syntax coverage is tracked in vastbase_official_syntax_coverage.csv.
